summary: A 360-degree revolve cut on a plain box panicked in truck's intersection-curve code (intersection_curve.rs:133, unwrap on None). The box is 20.4 x 12 x 10 (x -5.4..15, y -5..7, z 0..10, from a rectangle (-5.4, 7)..(15, -5) extruded 10 mm). The profile is a circle of radius r = 4.664761515876241 centred on a corner of the side face y = -5, sliced to that face: a quarter disc, revolved 360 degrees about the face's edge through the corner. The tool is a half ball whose pole lies on the box's edge, and the box must lose the eighth of the ball inside it, pi*r^3/6 = 53.148 mm^3. #5812 fixed only the panic: on SolidCraft's kernel the cut still failed with an ordinary error and left the box whole (the PR test accepts that outcome); the pole on the edge was left as kernel work. Here the corner is (15, -5, 10) and the axis the vertical edge x = 15, y = -5; every corner gives the same volume. The controls move the same quarter disc and its vertical axis so the pole lies on the face y = -5 (the box loses a quarter ball) or inside the box (a half ball). All turns are full, so the sweep's sense does not matter. The tolerance is 0.01 mm^3, as in the other boolean cases.

cases.name: pole_inside_box
cases.note: Control: the axis through (5, 1, 10), the middle of the top face. The half ball lies wholly in the box, its pole at (5, 1, 10 - r) inside it.

volume.formula: 20.4*12*10 - 1/2*4/3*pi*r^3, r = 4.664761515876241 (the box less the part of the half ball inside it, 212.59201591759202)

cases.name: pole_on_side_face
cases.note: Control: the axis through (5, -5, 10), on the side face y = -5. The pole lies on that face, and the box keeps the half of the half ball with y >= -5.

volume.formula: 20.4*12*10 - 1/4*4/3*pi*r^3, r = 4.664761515876241 (the box less the part of the half ball inside it, 106.29600795879601)

cases.name: pole_on_box_edge
cases.note: #5562: the axis is the box's vertical edge x = 15, y = -5. The pole lies on that edge, and the box keeps the quarter of the half ball with x <= 15, y >= -5.
